description: Angular component for configuring alarm schedules, including form handling, validation, and model synchronization.

classes.name: AlarmScheduleComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for alarm schedule configuration.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form and sets up value change subscriptions.

methods.name: validateDayOfWeeks
methods.description: Validates that at least one day of the week is selected.

methods.name: validateItems
methods.description: Validates that at least one enabled item exists.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for propagating form value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates the form with a given AlarmSchedule value.

methods.name: weeklyRepeatControl
methods.description: Returns the form control for a specific day of the week.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Adjusts validators based on the selected schedule type.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the internal model based on form values and propagates changes.

methods.name: defaultItemsScheduler
methods.description: Creates a default form group for schedule items.

methods.name: changeCustomScheduler
methods.description: Handles checkbox change for custom schedule items.

methods.name: disabledSelectedTime
methods.description: Enables or disables time controls for a schedule item.

methods.name: getSchedulerRangeText
methods.description: Returns a textual representation of the schedule range.

methods.name: itemsSchedulerForm
methods.description: Getter for the schedule items form array.
